title.en: B1 review and writing an opinion

title.en: Review: giving opinions and writing complaints

explain.ko: B1의 마지막 단원은 지금까지 배운 시제와 구조를 합쳐 의견이나 불만을 글로 쓰는 연습입니다. 좋은 글은 ① 입장(In my opinion, …), ② 이유(because, so that), ③ 반대 의견과 양보(however, although), ④ 결론(In conclusion, …)의 순서를 따릅니다. 불만 이메일에서는 Dear Sir or Madam으로 시작해 문제(The item I ordered hasn't arrived), 요구(I would like to request a refund), 마무리(I look forward to hearing from you)를 씁니다. 격식 있는 글에서는 줄임말을 피하고 정중한 표현(Could you …?)을 씁니다.
explain.en: The last B1 unit brings together the tenses and structures you have learnt to write an opinion or a complaint. A good text follows this order: (1) position (In my opinion, …), (2) reasons (because, so that), (3) an opposing view and concession (however, although), (4) conclusion (In conclusion, …). A complaint email starts with Dear Sir or Madam, then states the problem (The item I ordered hasn't arrived), the request (I would like to request a refund) and a closing line (I look forward to hearing from you). In formal writing avoid contractions and use polite forms (Could you …?).

head: 부분 / Part
표현 / Phrases
예문 / Example
rows: In my opinion, public transport should be cheaper.
It would reduce traffic because more people would use it.
however · although · on the other hand
However, some people worry that taxes will rise.
In conclusion, I support this proposal.
I'm writing to complain about … · I would like to request …
I would like to request a refund.

notes.ko: 의견 글은 입장 → 이유 → 반대 의견 → 결론 순서로 씁니다.
notes.en: Organise an opinion text as: position → reasons → counter-view → conclusion.

notes.ko: 불만은 사실(과거·현재완료), 요구(would like to), 마무리(look forward to + -ing) 순으로 정중하게 씁니다.
notes.en: State facts (past / present perfect), then your request (would like to), then close (look forward to + -ing) politely.

notes.ko: 격식 있는 편지에서는 줄임말(don't, I'm)을 피합니다.
notes.en: In formal letters, avoid contractions (don't, I'm).

lines.t: Hello. My name is Mark Dean, and I stayed at your hotel last weekend. The room wasn't clean and the air conditioning didn't work. I told the staff, but nothing was done. I would like to request a full refund, and I look forward to your reply within seven days.

items.passage:
SHOULD SCHOOL START LATER?
People who are in favour of starting school after nine say that teenagers need more sleep. Those who are against it point out that it doesn't fit the working hours of parents. One study found that students at schools with later start times got better grades. In the end, the decision depends on the local community.

trans.ko:
학교 시작 시간, 바꿔야 할까?
학교를 오전 9시 이후에 시작하는 것에 찬성하는 사람들은 청소년에게 더 많은 수면이 필요하다고 말합니다. 반대하는 사람들은 맞벌이 부모의 출근 시간과 맞지 않는다고 지적합니다. 한 연구에서는 시작 시간을 늦춘 학교의 학생들이 성적이 올랐다고 합니다. 결국 결정은 지역 사회의 상황에 달려 있습니다.

prompt.ko: 주제에 대한 의견을 5문장으로 써 보세요: 자기 의견, 이유, 반대 의견 한 가지, 결론, 마무리 인사 또는 요청.
prompt.en: Write 5 sentences giving your opinion on a topic: your view, a reason, an opposing view, a conclusion, and a closing request or greeting.

task.model: In my opinion, public transport should be cheaper. If it were, more people would use it, so there would be less traffic. However, some people worry that taxes will rise. In conclusion, I support this proposal. I look forward to hearing from you.

model_trans.ko: 제 생각에는 대중교통이 더 저렴해야 해요. 그러면 더 많은 사람이 이용해서 교통 체증이 줄어요. 하지만 일부 사람들은 세금이 오를 것이라고 걱정해요. 결론적으로 저는 이 제안을 지지합니다. 의견을 검토해 주시기 바랍니다.
model_trans.en: In my opinion, public transport should be cheaper. If it were, more people would use it, so there would be less traffic. However, some people worry that taxes will rise. In conclusion, I support this proposal. I look forward to hearing from you.
